subject.title: Add CUA as a delegated-run provider

question: Should Crabbox defer all first-class CUA support until upstream provides trustworthy create ownership, or sponsor a non-mutating doctor-only experimental surface in the meantime?
rationale: Current repository policy rejects inventory inference as resource ownership, while the available CUA create contract cannot safely resolve an ambiguous successful mutation; deciding whether a limited diagnostic surface has enough product value requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Defer mutating support
options.body: Keep the issue and linked pull request blocked until CUA exposes and live-proves a stable create-ownership primitive, then resume the full delegated-run provider.

options.title: Sponsor doctor-only support
options.body: Narrow the initial scope to explicit non-mutating prerequisite, authentication, and compatibility diagnostics without creating, adopting, or deleting sandboxes.

recommendation.title: Defer mutating support
recommendation.body: Keep the issue and linked pull request blocked until CUA exposes and live-proves a stable create-ownership primitive, then resume the full delegated-run provider.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on repository-wide provider scope and lifecycle-safety requirements reflected in recent architecture policy and VISION.md.
